proposed_widenings.name: grant_mastery_access
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature's core mechanic is a persistent entitlement to use mastery properties for a chosen set of weapon kinds. The surface can encode mastery properties themselves as standalone `mastery` records, but it has no effect atom that grants access to those properties through weapon-kind selections.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice, such as Greataxes and Handaxes.

proposed_widenings.name: long_rest_reconfigure_mastery_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature includes a deterministic reconfiguration rider tied to finishing a Long Rest: one chosen weapon kind can be replaced. Existing passive mechanics have no long-rest-triggered replace/choose grammar for persistent selections.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.

notes: A `class_feature` with passive semantics is the closest family fit, but authoring it honestly would require at least a new effect atom for mastery-access grants. I did not create a placeholder content record because no existing atom can express the feature's primary mechanic. The later-level increase in number of weapon kinds is secondary scaling pressure on the same missing concept.
